newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - PacifiCare falls.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - PacifiCare falls.

text.p: Shares in PacifiCare Health Systems Inc fell before Tuesday's market opening, weighed by a company announcement that its quarterly results would be below expectations.
The Cypress, Calif., company's "A" shares were trading at 71, down from a Monday Nasdaq close of 81. Its "B" shares were at 73, down from a Monday close of 85-1/2.
The company said after the close of trading Monday its earnings for the second quarter, ending June 30, would be below the First Call consensus estimate of $1.16 a share.

The health maintenance organization blamed the expected shortfall to substantially lower performance in a number of FHP International Co markets and in disappointing results in California last month. PacifiCare bought FHP in February.
Integon Corp was bid at 19, up from a Monday close of 16. General Motors Acceptance Corp and Integon said late Monday they had signed an agreement for Integon to merge with a GMAC subsidiary.
International Business Machines Corp was trading at 89-1/4 from a Monday close of 88 after Morgan Stanley raised its price target for the stock to $105 from $93.
Philip Morris Cos Inc was trading at 44 from a closing price of 42-3/4, traders said.
